Package bg.tu_varna.ks.command

package bg.tu_varna.ks.command
Subsystem for handling user commands.

Contains the list of supported commands (Command) and the logic for recognizing and executing them (CommandRunner). Concrete implementations of individual commands live in the sub-packages bg.tu_varna.ks.command.utility and bg.tu_varna.ks.command.events.
